items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Fletcher Henderson only in the context of Henderson arranging for Benny Goodman, stating 'That's true. Well that's terrible because he was so helpful and Benny Goodman's success really were with those arrangements.' No direct personal interaction between Jimmy McPartland an

ctx.x: Oh yes. Oh yes. I used to play a lot of golf. I loved the game. I stopped football quick when I got a broken rib, that was enough. So, Benny Goodman was a great, great guy. We were pals and you know when I went with Ben Pollack band then we played at the Black Hawk in Chicago and then we went to New York. Why we roomed together, Harry Goodman, Gil Rodin, Benny Goodman and myself. And we cooked for ourselves and everything else.

Talking about arrangers, you know Fletcher Henderson of course arranged for him for so long. And this disadvantage of the arranger is of course that he doesn't make any money after he gets paid initially.
